title: Strategyproofing Peer Assessment via Partitioning: The Price in Terms of Evaluators' Expertise
findings: The paper does not contain findings related to religion. Its focus is on developing and evaluating algorithms for strategyproof peer assessment to maximize evaluator expertise.
